answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 8795 Country: SG Title: Assalamualikum if a husband is completely drunken and unconscious and beat his wife,and he sayz talaaq 3 times, will the marriage relationship will be broken? Question: Assalamualikum if a husband is completely drunken and unconscious and beat his wife,and he sayz talaaq 3 times, will the marriage relationship will be broken? Answer ID: 8795 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2199/1789=B/1429) The Talaq given after drinking in state of intoxication is valid according to the Hanafi Fiqh; so in the case mentioned above three talaqs shall take place and the Nikah will be nullified. Now, the husband can not marry her without Shrai halalah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
